extraction_method: git cat-file blob <commit_sha>:<upstream_path>, byte-exact, no eol/filter conversion; per-file integrity proven by git blob sha1 recomputation (git_blob_sha1) against the pinned commit tree

license.redistribution_note: Storage policy VENDORED: candidate snapshot bytes are not tracked in Git during the candidate stage; the later final-corpus freeze may vendor these bytes publicly under the license recorded here, with LICENSE/NOTICE/attribution artifacts preserved under licenses/ (hashes in this manifest).

scope_rationale: Scope = the EIPS/ directory (EIP documents). Root READMEs and administrative pages are outside the frame; recorded as unselected in the complete inventory.
storage_policy_rationale: Permissive/attribution license recorded from the upstream license material at the pinned commit (CC0-1.0); LICENSE/NOTICE/attribution artifacts are preserved under licenses/ with hashes. Public vendoring of the FINAL frozen corpus remains a later, separately reviewed decision; this policy records no new legal claims and does not resolve license interpretation questions.
